title: Harness / Lanyard Inspection
name: Harness / Lanyard Inspection
description: Inspection checklist for fall-arrest and restraint harnesses, lanyards and connectors before use or as part of a recorded equipment inspection regime.

sections.title: WEBBING / STITCHING / LABELS
items: Webbing is free from cuts, tears, abrasion, burns and chemical contamination
Stitching is intact with no broken or pulled threads
Labels and identification markings are legible
No unauthorised modification, knotting or repair is present

sections.title: METALWORK / CONNECTORS
items: D-rings, buckles and adjusters are free from distortion and excessive wear
Hooks / karabiners close and lock correctly
No sharp edges, cracks or corrosion affect safe use
Energy absorber is not deployed and packaging / stitching is intact where fitted

sections.title: SERVICEABILITY / HISTORY
items: Inspection / service history is available where required
Equipment has not been involved in a fall or shock-loading event unless formally cleared
Storage condition has not exposed the equipment to damage
Equipment remains within manufacturer service / inspection requirements
